summary: iter159 LIVE BALANCE & STATS updates — frontend live-refresh wiring verified end-to-end via 2-browser-context Playwright. All 5 acceptance flows PASS: VIP balance/frozen-note update live on withdrawal create+cancel, admin /admin/withdrawals table gains new row without F5, admin /admin/revenue re-fetches on order approval, admin /admin/company-funds re-fetches on withdrawal_status_changed. No console errors, no reload loops, EventSource stable.
critical_code_review_comments: useLiveRefresh (hooks/useLiveStream.jsx:184) correctly debounces bursts of events using a single trailing setTimeout — verified experimentally: revenue re-fetches 3x after order approval (one per distinct event burst spaced beyond 1.2s debounce window: ledger_changed, order_status_changed, balance_updated at different times), not 3x per event.

eventsKey = JSON.stringify(events) in useLiveRefresh is a nice trick to allow inline array literal without re-subscribing on every render. Callers must still pass module-level constants (as CF_LIVE_EVENTS does) to avoid unnecessary JSON serialisation on re-renders — worth noting in a JSDoc.

Company-funds hook subscribes to daily_autoclose event but this event is not in the SSE forward list in LiveStreamProvider (line 93-107). Wait — actually line 105 lists daily_autoclose. Verified — good.
AdminRevenue useLiveRefresh call at line 59 omits the 4th arg (delay) so uses default 1200ms — matches the spec (revenue debounce 1200ms).
AdminOrders/AdminWithdrawals use explicit delay=800ms for snappier queue UX. Verified: WID2 appears in admin table within ~4s including 800ms debounce + fetch latency.

LIVE TEST 2: POST /api/vip/withdrawals/{id}/cancel → USD card restored to 1,000 and frozen back to 3,982.86 within ~4s (no reload).

LIVE TEST 3: With admin's /admin/withdrawals open, a POST /api/vip/withdraw call from a separate request inserted the new withdrawal id into the admin table DOM within ~4s (found via substring match on withdrawal id) — no F5 required.

LIVE TEST 4: With admin's /admin/revenue open, PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status status=approved triggered 3 additional network requests to /api/admin/revenue* endpoints within 5s — hook re-fetched revenue as expected on order_status_changed + ledger_changed + balance_updated events (debounced to at most 1 fetch per 1.2s window, but 3 distinct bursts were observed).

LIVE TEST 5: With admin's /admin/company-funds open, POST /api/vip/withdrawals/{id}/cancel triggered 2 additional /api/admin/company-funds/* network requests within ~4.5s (withdrawal_status_changed + balance_updated + ledger_changed debounced to a single reload burst).

REGRESSION: 0 revenue network calls in a 5s idle window after the initial burst → no infinite reload loop. EventSource connects with cookies (withCredentials=true). No console errors from live/stream endpoint or hook. LiveToaster still displays toasts (per iter155/156 — expected, ignored per request).
